digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (orchestrator, detection floor, routing, kernel)
propositions: Implement plan-review decomposition recommendations R1-R7 from SOTA report with eval-based validation and advisory-first strategy (no A/B testing, no config-flag gating).

R1/R3/R4 ship in advisory posture (never block) with bounded sanity checks and standing dogfood monitoring via criterion_effectiveness.py; advisory→blocking promotion gate is FP-evidence-driven (10% FP threshold).

E1 outcome corpus frozen and committed; E2/E3 batch-eval gate permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5 standing effectiveness recorder; E1 inter-rater-κ corpus descoped (contamination ~79%).
R6 ships deterministic-first with no eval gate; R7 instrumentation lands first to enable dogfood monitoring before detection changes.
R2 (DET floor lint) does not touch criteria_routing.json (file-impact: det_floor.py); R3/R4/R5 serialize on criteria_routing.json/review_kernel to avoid conflicts with floor-split story.
